title: Rosalind and the Cellar
author: M. M. Zhou
blurb: Juniper Villalobos, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
